items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I remember Giggy Williams, the guitar player in the original Creole band, when I first met him, also 1940 in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: We don't know what it's got. Kind of a rough kind of theory, but.

Probably Louie always was sensational in, soon after he started here and all, at least he, he probably, as far as his lip goes and a certain expressiveness there that was. But, so naturally he attracted attention and following and then he would try to please those people too. So when he got to Chicago and soon after that he became a more or less of a soloist. But, say, the Hot Fives, which have the small traditional group, you know, say five to seven players, but he still did a different style. I remember Giggy…
